subject.title: fix(acpx): keep leaked non-openai model out of the Codex ACP thinking slot

question: Should OpenClaw accept the additive ACP runtime contract fields and provenance-aware fail-closed Codex model policy in this PR as the compatibility path for the linked Codex ACP spawn bug?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it deliberately expands a plugin-facing runtime contract and changes model-routing behavior for explicit unsupported Codex selections, which requires owner acceptance rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Accept this contract
options.body: Approve the optional modelExplicit/appliedModel contract and provenance-aware policy, then rebase/clear the stale requested-changes review before merge.

options.title: Keep the contract private
options.body: Ask for a narrower implementation that keeps provenance/effective-model reporting internal to core and ACPX if maintainers do not want the public ACP runtime types expanded.

options.title: Pause for downstream proof
options.body: Wait for the downstream reporter to validate a test build if maintainer confidence depends on production-environment confirmation beyond the supplied live output.

recommendation.title: Accept this contract
recommendation.body: Approve the optional modelExplicit/appliedModel contract and provenance-aware policy, then rebase/clear the stale requested-changes review before merge.
